title: Recursive Eight-Way Spatialization Families
objective: Implement the bounded candidate mappings from base-100 routes into recursive one-to-eight refinement.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.addressing (path_cell), cwatlas.subdivision (one-to-eight refinement), cwatlas.localize (cell_centroid) - NOT reimplemented

implementation.family_conventions: token_order (significance) x face_entry (DIRECT | ROOT_RELATIVE) x digit_order (BIG_ENDIAN | LITTLE_ENDIAN); each a pure arithmetic bijection route <-> (face, octal path)

negative_results: No hash and no destination catalogue: each family is a pure arithmetic bijection (required work #3).
A spatialization is a CALIBRATED_CANDIDATE at most - one member of a bounded ensemble, not a measured location, not a decoded destination, no validated source origin.
The correct family, if any, is chosen only by sealed-anchor calibration, never by result shopping.

claims.statement: The bounded four-family ensemble maps five-token base-100 routes to (face, octal path) with deterministic cell polygons and centroids, each family invertible and counted for the search-space ledger.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public planted routes only (sanitized 165876523 route shape); no private narrative, no personal names or filesystem literals
